product_one_liner.value: Karbon is cloud-based practice management software for accounting firms that combines client management, email, task management, invoicing and payments in one platform.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists Team, Business and Enterprise plans.

employee_band.notes: Company size reported on Karbon's LinkedIn page.

hq_location.notes: The LEI registry's headquarters address and Karbon's LinkedIn page both identify San Francisco.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index shows product-release and hiring posts; no qualifying set of two engineer-authored posts about building the product was identified.

public_docs.notes: Public developer center includes API documentation, authentication guidance, webhook guides and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: AI Operations Lead — remote, United States.

model_provider.notes: Karbon's help documentation explicitly identifies this service as powering Karbon AI.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II certification and self-assessed GDPR compliance. ISO 27001 is excluded because Karbon explicitly says it is not independently certified; PCI DSS statements concern Stripe.

last_funding.notes: Latest recorded financing was July 17, 2024, classified as Later Stage VC / Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round, July 17, 2024, predates the 18-month window.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced Kai, an AI coworker embedded in Karbon, on June 3, 2026; Kai was announced as available in early access.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Karbon announced Brooke Brockman's appointment as Chief Marketing Officer on November 11, 2025.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Account Executive, SMB posting requires maintaining information and forecasts in Salesforce/Gong.
